scenario.title: Busy walk-in, limited kit (challenging)
scenario.environment_label: Community walk-in clinic (no imaging on site)

calm: I'll hold your bag, don't worry about it.
Just tell them what happened, like you told me.
Take your time, Alex. I'm right here.
anxious: Shouldn't someone more senior be looking at this?
Is it serious? Please tell me it's not serious.
Sorry. I'll let you work. I'm just worried.
Alex needs that hand for work. How long is this going to take?

events.label: Crowd noise increases

interventions.label: A helper arrives

line.text: Hi, I'm Kim, one of the nurses. Tell me what you need and I'll fetch it.
